contests.title: Fairfield Community School District — Measure LR: Middle school improvement bonds

provenance.sourceOrg: Wapello County Iowa Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote:
Shall the Board of Directors of the
Fairfield Community School District in
the Counties of Jefferson, Henry,
Van Buren, Wapello and
Washington, State of Iowa, be
authorized to contract indebtedness
and issue General Obligation Bonds
in an amount not to exceed
$24,850,000 to provide funds to build
furnish, and equip additions to and to
remodel, repair, improve, and equip
the middle school building, including
fine arts, career and technical
education, library, commons area,
kitchen, and gymnasium spaces,
including related site improvements?

contests.title: Independence — Measure CD: Fire protection facility bonds

provenance.sourceOrg: Buchanan County Iowa Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote:
Shall the City of Independence, in Buchanan County, 
State of Iowa, enter into a loan agreement and issue 
general obligation bonds in an amount not 
exceeding $14,500,000 for the purpose of paying the 
cost, to that extent, of undertaking fire protection 
facilities improvements, including the expansion, 
renovation, furnishing and equipping of existing 
facilities and the acquisition and improvement of 
real estate for the development of additional 
facilities?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes up to $24.85 million in general-obligation bonds for middle school additions and renovations, including fine arts, career and technical education, library, common areas, kitchen and gymnasium spaces, and related site improvements.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the middle school improvement bonds.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes a loan agreement and up to $14.5 million in general-obligation bonds to expand, renovate, furnish and equip existing fire protection facilities, and acquire and improve real estate for additional facilities.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the fire protection facility borrowing.
